rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kin, the poor even when unrelated, and travelers should receive their due as acts of piety and beneficence.
rows.anchor: عم بالأمر به الكل ذي رحم وغيره , فقال تعالى : { وءات ذا القربى } من جهة الأب أو الأم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Waste is spending money extravagantly on what is improper; generosity instead follows measured financial duties set by God.
rows.anchor: والتبذير : بسط اليد في المال على حسب الهوى جزافا , وأما الجود فبمقدار معلوم

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud defines waste as spending money outside its rightful use.
rows.anchor: ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه عن التبذير فقال : إنفاق المال من غير حقه

rows.speaker: مجاهد
rows.claim: Mujahid says spending all one's wealth on a rightful purpose is not waste, while spending even a mudd on falsehood is.
rows.anchor: وهن مجاهد رضي الله عنه : لو أنفق الإنسان ماله كله في الحق ما كان تبذيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wasteful spenders are called Satan's brothers because their conduct resembles destructive fire; Arabs call committed followers brothers.
rows.anchor: والعرب تقول لكل ملازم سنة قوم وتابع أمرهم : هو أخوهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan is ungrateful to his Lord because he conceals manifest signs and great blessings despite knowing the evidence.
rows.anchor: ستورا لما يقدر على ستره من آياته الظاهرة , ونعمه الباهرة , مع الحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If need forces a person to turn away from those seeking aid, it should be from inability rather than unwillingness, with kind words that sustain hope.
rows.anchor: لا لإرادة المنع , بل { ابتغاء } أي طلب { رحمة } أي إكرام وسعة

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Abu Hayyan reports that when the Prophet had nothing to give, he would ask God to provide for both him and the petitioner.
rows.anchor: قال أبو حيان : وروي أنه عليه الصلاة والسلام كان بعد نزول هذه الآية إذا لم يكن عنده ما يعطي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse names seeking mercy in place of poverty because poverty is the cause of seeking provision from God.
rows.anchor: وقد وضع هنا الابتغاء موضع الفقر لأنه سببه , فوضع السبب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hand imagery condemns both miserly restraint and unbounded giving: either exceeds balance, bringing blame or leaving one depleted.
rows.anchor: وكل من الحالتين مجاوز لحد الاعتدال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cave sleepers are wondrous, but not uniquely so beside God's innumerable signs in creation, which people overlook through familiarity.
rows.anchor: ليسوا بعجب بالنسبة إلى كثرة آياتنا , وبالنسبة إلى هذا العجب النباتي الذي أعرضتم عنه بإلفكم له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The yearly cycle of plants emerging, dying into indistinguishable soil, and returning is a greater wonder than preserved bodies being revived.
rows.anchor: ثم يرسل الماء فيختط بالتراب فيجمعه أخضر يانعا يهتز بالنمو على أحسن ما كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cave is a broad, mountain-cut cavern like a house; al-Raqim may mean a village or a mountain.
rows.anchor: الكهف } أي الغار الواسع المنقور في الجبل كالبيت { والرقيم } أي القرية أو الجبل

rows.speaker: أبو حيان
rows.claim: Abu Hayyan reports competing proposed locations for the cave: Rome, Syria, or Andalusia near Granada and Loja.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو حيان : قيل : هو في الروم , وقيل : في الشام , وقيل : في الأندلس

rows.speaker: ابن عطية
rows.claim: Ibn Atiyya says he visited the Granada-area cave in 504 AH, seeing bodies, a mosque, and a nearby Roman structure called al-Raqim.
rows.anchor: ونقل عن ابن عطية قال : دخلت إليهم سنة أربع وخمسمائة فرأيتهم بهذه الحالة وعليهم مسجد

rows.speaker: أبو حيان
rows.claim: Abu Hayyan transmits his father's account that people visited an Andalusian cave, miscounted its sleepers, and said a dog was with them.
rows.anchor: ونقل أبو حيان عن أبيه أنه حين كان بالأندلس كان الناس يزورون هذا الكهف ويذكرون أنهم يغلطون في عدتهم

rows.speaker: أبو حيان
rows.claim: Abu Hayyan favors the Andalusian location, citing the reported cave and traces of Decius's old city near Granada.
rows.anchor: قال : ويترجح كون أصحاب الكهف بالأندلس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author doubts the Andalusian identification and says the famous location is better supported by a report from Ibn Abbas.
rows.anchor: قلت : وفيه نظر , والذي يرجح المشهور ما نقل البغوي وغيره

rows.speaker: سعيد بن جبير عن ابن عباس
rows.claim: A report attributed through Said ibn Jubayr to Ibn Abbas says, “We campaigned in the lands of Andalusia.”
rows.anchor: ما نقل البغوي وغيره عن سعيد بن جبير عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال : غزونا مع بلاد الأندلس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths were few and inexperienced, yet youth makes people more receptive to truth and better guided than elders.
rows.anchor: والشبان أقبل للحق وأهدى للسبيل من الشيوخ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their flight to the cave for their faith parallels Muhammad and Abu Bakr retreating to the cave of Thawr.
rows.anchor: فرارا بدينهم كما أويت أنت والصديق إلى غار ثور فرارا بدينكما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Harali distinguishes customary, extraordinary, and divinely bestowed orders of events; the youths ask for the highest, hidden kind of mercy.
rows.anchor: على ثلاث رتب : حكيمات جارية على قوانين العادات , وعنديات خارقة للمطردات ولدنيات مستغرقة في الأمور الخارقات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask for exceptional divine mercy and a way toward deliverance and right guidance in both worlds; their request is granted beyond expectation.
rows.anchor: وجها ترشدنا فيه إلى الخلاص في الدارين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Striking their ears means sealing them against sound with a deep sleep that ordinary noise could not disturb.
rows.anchor: سددناها وأمسكناها عن السمع , وكان أصله ؛ ضربنا عليها حجابا بنوم ثقيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The indefinite wording for their years reflects the indeterminate duration amid the polytheism of that age.
rows.anchor: ولما كانت مدة لبثهم نكرة بما كان لأهل ذلك الزمان من الشرك , عبر بما يدل على النكرة

rows.speaker: الزجاج
rows.claim: Al-Zajjaj says a counted item described as a number implies abundance, since a small number needs no counting to be understood.
rows.anchor: قال الزجاج كل شيء مما يعد إذا ذكر فيه العدد ووصف أريد كثرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God awakened them so that their situation and the competing groups' estimates would become manifest to observers, though God already knew it unseen.
rows.anchor: علما مشاهدا لغيرنا كما كنا نعلم غيبا ما جهله من يسأل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two groups are the sleepers and those who later encountered them; the latter estimated duration from their coins or other clues.
rows.anchor: هم أو من عير عليهم من أهل إحصاءه لمدة لبثهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their estimate of a day or part of one could be close to the truth but remained conjectural, unlike God's certain knowledge.
rows.anchor: فعلى سبيل الظن والتقريب , لا القطع والتحديد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The groups' ignorance of the sleepers' duration demonstrates God's perfect knowledge and that He has neither child nor partner in rule.
rows.anchor: علم أنه المحيط بصفات الكمال , وأنه لم ينخذ ولدا , ولا له شريك في الملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God recounts the story in detail and truthfully, unlike other tellings that may add to or omit from it.
rows.anchor: نخبر إخبارا تابعا لآثارهم قدما فقدما { عليك } على وجه التفصيل { نبأهم بالحق }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths believed in their Lord, who created and provided for them and endowed them with sound, useful reason.
rows.anchor: المحسن إليهم الناظر في مصالحهم الذي تفرد بخلقهم ورزقهم , وهداهم بما وهب لهم في أصل الفطرة من العقول الجيدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After their initial faith, God increased their guidance by granting knowledge and opening their hearts, enabling sacrifice and renunciation of worldly life.
rows.anchor: بما قذفنا في قلوبهم من المعارف , وشرحنا لهم صدورهم من المواهب التي حملتهم على ارتكاب المعاطب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God strengthened their hearts by gathering their inner powers rather than letting them disperse, making them steadfast in public as in private.
rows.anchor: قويناها , فصار ما فيها من القوى مجتمعا غير مبدد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They stood before the unbelieving generation's tyrant, Decius, and declared that the Lord of heaven and earth alone deserves worship.
rows.anchor: في ذلك الجيل الكافرين بين يدي طاغيتهم دقيانوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They reject invoking any deity besides God as an extreme departure from truth, since all others are incapable and lack evidence.
rows.anchor: بعد أن ثبت عجز كل من سواه , والله { لقد قلنا إذا } أي إذا دعونا من دونه غيره { شططا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths challenge their people to provide clear proof for their idols, rejecting unproven imitation in foundational matters of faith.
rows.anchor: فساد التقليد في أصول الدين وأنه لا مقنع فيه بدون القطع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Associating partners with God without proof is a deliberate fabrication and the greatest injustice against the sovereign Lord.
rows.anchor: عجزهم عن دليل أنهم أظلم الظالمين لافتعالهم الكذب عن ملك الملوك ومالك الملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since the youths lacked power against their numerous opponents, they migrated to preserve their faith after exposing their opponents' folly.
rows.anchor: وهم قوم لا يدان لهم بمقاومتهم , لكثرتهم وقلتهم , تسبب عن ذلك هجرتهم ليسلم لهم دينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their separation from their people and their worship indicates that their community practiced polytheism.
rows.anchor: وهذا دليل على أنهم كانوا يشركون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A possible interpretation is that they called the people's coerced submission to God's will and decrees a form of worship.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكونوا سموا الانقياد كرها لمشيئته والخضوع بزعمهم لاقضيته عبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They take refuge in the cave because they have withdrawn from their people; God will extend enough mercy and prepare a useful comfort for them.
rows.anchor: فأوا } أي بسبب هذا الاعتزال , وهذا دليل العامل في { إذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hope rests on God's power to protect whoever seeks refuge in Him and trusts Him; He fulfills it by letting them sleep and raising them centuries later.
rows.anchor: فعلوا ذلك ففعل الله ما رجوه فيه , فجعل لهم أحسن مرفق بأن أنامهم ثم أقامهم بعد مضي قرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reading مرفقا has kasra on mim and fatha on fa for most readers, but fatha on mim and kasra on fa for Nafi and Ibn Amir.
rows.anchor: وهو بكسر الميم وفتح الفاء في قراءة الجماعة , وبفتحها وكسر الفاء للنافع وابن عامر

rows.speaker: نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو
rows.claim: These readers assimilate the ta of the tafaʿul form in تزاور.
rows.anchor: أدغم تاء التفاعل نافع وابن كثير وأبو عمرو

rows.speaker: عاصم وحمزة والكسائي
rows.claim: These readers omit the ta in the recitation of تزاور.
rows.anchor: وأسقطها عاصم وحمزة والكسائي

rows.speaker: ابن عامر ويعقوب
rows.claim: They read تزور on the pattern of تحمر, which the author relates to the sun's state at the end of its inclination.
rows.anchor: ولعل قراءة ابن عامر ويعقوب تزور بوزن تحمر ناظرة إلى الحال عند نهاية الميل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun inclines away at dawn and veers aside at sunset so its warmth benefits the sleepers without overheating or harming them.
rows.anchor: لئلا يضرهم شدة الحرارة , ويصيبهم من منافعها مثل ما كان عند الطلوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author infers a cave entrance facing Banat Naash and a mountain north of Mecca, but says the directions may instead be relative to someone leaving the cave.
rows.anchor: وأن الجبل الذي هم في شمالي مكة المشرفة , ويجوز أن يكون المراد يمين من يخرج من الكهف وشماله , فلا يلزم ذلك

rows.speaker: الأصبهاني
rows.claim: Al-Asbahani reports that the cave entrance faced north, with sunrise to its right and sunset to its left.
rows.anchor: وقال الأصبهاني : قيل : إن باب ذلك كان مفتوحا إلى جانب الشمال إذا طلعت الشمس عن يمين الكهف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The root of قرض centers on cutting, from which the senses of veering aside, passing, and giving a loan cut from one's wealth are derived.
rows.anchor: ومادة ( قرض ) وليس لها إلا هذا التركيب - تدور على القطع , ويلزمه الميل عن الشيء والعدول والازورار عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sleepers lie in the cave's broad central space, where fresh air helps preserve them from decay and other harm.
rows.anchor: أي في وسط الكهف ومتسعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their guidance, planning, and the cave's protective ventilation are signs of God's knowledge and power, even if small beside the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: { ذلك } أي المذكور العظيم من هدايتهم , وما دبروا لأنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only those whom God guides benefit from His signs; the misguided see and hear them but fail to understand or use them.
rows.anchor: فتجده يرى الآيات بعينه , ويسمعها بأذنه , ويحسها بجميع حواسه , ولا يعلم أنها آيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage uses احتباك: guidance in the first clause implies omitted misguidance, while the later mention of a guiding protector implies an omitted misleader.
rows.anchor: فالآية من الاحتباك : ذكر الاهتداء أولا دليلا على حذف الضلال ثاينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They seem awake because their eyes are open to the air and they move often, although they are deeply asleep.
rows.anchor: لانفتاح أعينهم للهواء ليكون أبقى لها , ولكثرة حركاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God turns them from side to side so fresh air reaches every part and prolonged contact with the ground does not harm them.
rows.anchor: لينال روح النسيم جميع أبدانهم ولا يتأثر ما يلي الأرض منها بطول المكث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present participle باسط depicts the dog's continuing past posture; its companionship with the virtuous brings honor even to the dog.
rows.anchor: وأعمل اسم الفالع هذا , لأنه ليس بمعنى الماضي بل هو حكاية حال ماضية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The الوصيد is the cave's doorway or courtyard, where dogs customarily lie.
rows.anchor: بالوصيد } أي بباب الكهف وفنائه كما هي عادة الكلاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gave the sleepers awe and majesty so that anyone seeing them would flee in terror.
rows.anchor: لما ألبسهم الله من الهيبة , وجعل لهم من الجلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their revival and questions deepen their faith and certainty by revealing God's comprehensive knowledge and power, answering deniers of resurrection.
rows.anchor: فيزدادوا إيمانا , وثباتا وإيقانا , بما ينكشف لهم من الأمور العجيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The story answers Quraysh's consultation with Jewish questioners: either the Jews' admission should lead both to faith, or their denial shows signs cannot guide everyone.
rows.anchor: فإن كانوا يستنحصون اليهود فليسألوهم عما قصصنا من هذه القصة , فإن اعترفوا به لزمهم جميعا الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The questioner sensed a long sleep from the sleepers' appearance or other indications; their answer of a day or part was only conjecture.
rows.anchor: وهذا يدل على أن هذا القائل استشعر طول لبثهم بما رأى من هيئتهم أو لغير ذلك من الأمارات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's acceptance of their mistaken estimate shows that reasoned conjecture is permissible and is not a lie merely because it misses the fact.
rows.anchor: وأنه لا يسمى كذبا وإن كان مخالفا للواقع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They end the disagreement by entrusting the hidden duration to God, and their agreement reflects affection and fellowship in faith.
rows.anchor: ردوا الأمر إلى الله بقوله : { قالوا } أي قال بعضهم إنكارا على أنفسهم ووافق الباقون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They send one of their group with their silver money to their former city, Tarsus, to find the purest and best food.
rows.anchor: إلى المدينة } التي خرجتم منها وهي طرطوس ليأتينا بطعان فإنا جياع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The envoy must act tactfully and avoid alerting anyone, including through unintended actions that reveal the group.
rows.anchor: وإن المعنى : لا يقولن ولا يفعلن ما يؤدي من غير قصد منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their conduct shows that a traveler may carry provisions while relying on God, and the account supports the validity of agency.
rows.anchor: وفي قصتهم دليل على أن حمل المسافر ما يصلحه من المنفعة رأى المتوكلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author derives الورق and its related forms from a root associated with gathering, explaining silver coins by their shape, beauty, and role in a person's livelihood.
rows.anchor: بجميع تراكيبها الخمسة عشر قد تقدم في سورة سبحان وغيرها أنها تدور على الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lexical family includes foliage, worldly beauty, paper, animal life, fallen blood, and wealth; these senses are tied to beauty, life, and the gathering of human affairs.
rows.anchor: والورق : المال من إبل ودارهم وغيرها - لأن جماع حياة الإنسان وكمالها بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Waraq can mean a group's beauty or its young and weak men; الورقة may mean either a lowly or noble person depending on which aspect is considered.
rows.anchor: والورق من القوم : أحداثهم أو الضعاف من الفتيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Related forms describe both failure and prosperity: a hunter or group may return fruitless, while الأورقوا can also mean gaining much wealth.
rows.anchor: ومن ذلك أورق الصائد - إذا رمى فأخطأ أي لم يقع على غير الورق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extended lexicon gives varied meanings for foliage and verdure, early pasture, a variegated wolf, and a flaw in a bow, linking these to color, usefulness, or lack of fruit.
rows.anchor: والورقاء : الذئبة - من أجل أن الورق الخالي عن الثمر تقل الرغبة في شجره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Related q-w-r forms describe walking on tiptoe or stalking prey, carving circular openings, compact hills and rocks, spacious houses, and states of gathering or contraction.
rows.anchor: وقار الرجل يقور : مشى على أطراف قدميه لئلا يسمع صوتهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author connects these senses through gathering, separation, or cutting, and cites the proverb قد أنصف القارة من رماها for the tribe called Qara.
rows.anchor: وفي المثل : قد أنصف القارة من رماها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths fear stoning if caught steadfast in their faith, or coercion into the city's religion; sincere return would lead Satan to draw them into it permanently.
rows.anchor: لأنكم وإن أكرهتم ربما استدرجكم الشيطان بذلك إلى الإجابة حقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The envoy escaped notice from opponents, but a sympathetic king discovered the sleepers because he shared their religion, so the warning was not breached.
rows.anchor: وإنما أشعر بهم الملك لما رآه موافقا لهم في الدين لأنه لم يقع النهي عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's making the sleepers known encompasses strengthening their hearts, concealing them, protecting them from oppressors, and preserving their bodies over time.
rows.anchor: فعلنا بهم ذلك الأمر العظيم من الربط على قلوبهم , والستر لأخبارهم والحماية من الظالمين والحفظ لأجسامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preserved bodies and revival after more than three centuries demonstrate bodily resurrection against those who thought only souls would be raised.
rows.anchor: لأن اعتقاد اليهود والنصارى أن البعث إنما هو للروح فقط

rows.speaker: بعض العارفين
rows.claim: A wise teacher says waking after sleep teaches resurrection after death; the intermediate state is one, though the soul remains attached to the body in sleep.
rows.anchor: كما قال بعض العارفين ( علمك باليقظة بعد النوم علم بالبعث بعد الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is beyond doubt, supported by rational evidence and decisive transmitted proofs.
rows.anchor: لما قام علهيا من أدلة العقل , المؤيد في كل عصر بقواطع النقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disputants debate whether resurrection is only of souls or includes bodies, and whether the sleepers were righteous or their state was unknown.
rows.anchor: فقائل يقول : تحشر الأرواح مجردة : وقائل يقول : بأجسادها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The party in control proposes a building over them; the author prefers reading the phrase as city leaders or powerful people, whom God made righteous.
rows.anchor: ويجوز - وهو أحسن - أن يكون الضمير لأهل البلد أو للغالبين أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author infers the sleepers died again after their discovery, before all details were investigated; their story encourages migration.
rows.anchor: وفي قصتهم ترغيب في الهجرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first two headcounts omit the conjunction before the dog's ordinal, which the author treats as evidence that they are wrong guesses.
rows.anchor: ولذلك أعراه عن الواو فدل إسقاطها على أنها ليسوا ثلاثة وليس الكلب رابعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase رجما بالغيب marks the five-person count as speculation; the seven-person count, introduced with conjunction, is presented as certain.
rows.anchor: وتأخير هذا عن الرجم - وإن كان ظنا - مشعر بأنه حق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conjunction can emphasize a firmly attached predicate, as in the Qur'anic phrase about every town having a known decree.
rows.anchor: فإن فائدتها توكيد لصوق الصفة بالموصوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a few people know the sleepers' number; this supports the prevalent seven-person view, and Ibn Abbas says he is among the few.
rows.anchor: وهو مؤيد لأنهم أصحاب القول الغالب

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies himself as one of the few who know the sleepers' number.
rows.anchor: قول ابن عباس رضي الله عنهمان وكان يقول : أنا من ذلك القليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should avoid disputing with people who speak without revelation, limiting discussion to the apparent evidence God revealed, and should not consult Israelite claimants.
rows.anchor: أي تجادل وتراجع { فيهم } أحدا ممن يتكلم بغير ما أخبرتك به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person should not state a resolved plan for tomorrow, trivial or important, without connecting it to God's will and acknowledging dependence on Him.
rows.anchor: أي لأجل شيء من الأشياء التي يعزم عليها جليها وحقيرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A promise made without saying God willing may fail through an obstacle and become falsehood that repels listeners.
rows.anchor: وأنه إن قيل ذلك دون استثناء فات قبل الفعل أو عاقه عنه عائق كان كذبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When one forgets to make an exception, remembering God and invoking His will upon recollection is not culpable.
rows.anchor: حال النسيان { إذا نسيت } الاستثناء بالاستعانة والتوكل عليه

rows.speaker: الطبراني عن ابن عباس
rows.claim: Al-Tabarani transmits from Ibn Abbas that this instruction was specific to the Prophet; others may attach an exception only to an oath.
rows.anchor: وأخرج الطبراني في معجمه الأوسط في ترجمة محمد بن الحارث الجبيلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aqرب is the comparative from the intransitive قَرُبَ, unlike the transitive root used in prohibitions against approaching adultery or orphan property.
rows.anchor: و ( اقرب ) أفعل تفضيل من قرب - بضم الراء - من الشيء , لازم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nearer guidance is to infer prophethood, divine oneness, and resurrection from broad or frequent signs rather than this rare, demanding detail.
rows.anchor: بالأمور الكلية أو الجزيئات القريبة المتكررة , ولا بهذا الأمر الجزئي النادر المتعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three hundred years are solar years, using the reckoning of the Jewish questioners; the wording also alludes to the era's unbelieving rule and persecution.
rows.anchor: شمسية بحساب اليهود الآمرين بهذا السؤال , وعبر بلفظ السنة إشارة إلى ذمها وقع فيها من علو أهل الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The added nine years are lunar, converting the three hundred solar years to the Arabs' lunar reckoning based on the difference between year lengths.
rows.anchor: لأن تفاوت ما بين السنة الشمسية والقمرية عشرة أيام وإحدى وعشرون ساعة وخمسا ساعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone knows the sleepers' duration because He comprehends all unseen things, never forgets, and cannot be thwarted in what is to come.
rows.anchor: يعلمه كله على ما هو عليه , ولا ينسى شيئا من الماضي ولا يعزب عنه شيء من الحاضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expressions of seeing and hearing proclaim that God's perception is perfect beyond human comprehension and is the basis of knowledge.
rows.anchor: ولما كان السمع والبصر مناطي العلم , وكان متصفا منهما بما لا يعلمه حق علمه غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No guardian can shield anyone from God or replace His report; no one shares in His judgment or can report independently of His command.
rows.anchor: ولا يشرك } أي الله { في حكمه أحدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet must persist in reciting the revealed Book to those who seek it and trust its promise, warning, affirmation, and denial.
rows.anchor: اقرأ على وجه الملازمة { ما أوحي إليك } وبنى الفعل للمجهول لأن الخطاب مع النبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's words cannot be changed or fail; abrogation does not count as alteration in the sense intended here.
rows.anchor: والنسخ ليس بتبديل بهذا المعنى بل هو غاية لما كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet has no refuge if he falls short in conveying the message entrusted to him.
rows.anchor: أي ملجأ ومتحيزا إليه فيمنعك منه إن قصرت في ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was grieving over unbelievers, while leaders offered to listen if he expelled poor believers such as Ammar, Suhaib, and Bilal.
rows.anchor: لو طردت هؤلاء الفقراء وأبعدتهم عنك مثل عمار وصهيب وبلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He must remain with believers who call on God morning and evening seeking His face alone, even if they are socially poor.
rows.anchor: يريدون } أي بذلك { وجهه } لا غير ذلك في رجاء ثواب أو خوف عقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He must not turn toward worldly adornment or obey those whom God has made heedless, who follow desire and exceed all bounds.
rows.anchor: هوه } بالميل إلى ما استدرجناه به منها والأنفة من مجالسة أوليائنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author reads أغفلنا as God's action: He caused the heart to be heedless, and the consequent loss of remembrance leaves darkness for desire to fill.
rows.anchor: ولما كان التقدير : فغفل , لأن عظمتنا لا يغلبها شيء فلا يكون إلا ما نريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The followers will be rescued and raised over tyrants as the cave sleepers were, because they turn to God and away from everything else.
rows.anchor: سينجي أتباعك على ضعفهم منهم كما أنجى أصحاب الكهف , ويزيدك بأن يعليهم عليهم
